data.sub: Mumbai mein Amitabh Bachchan ke ghar firing plan fail
data.asar: Mumbai Police alert par hai aur jaanch jari hai.
data.caption:
Mumbai Police ne Bollywood megastar Amitabh Bachchan ke ghar par firing ki planning ko fail kar diya hai.

🚨 Mamle mein 2 shooters ko Mumbai Police ne arrest kiya hai.
📱 Aaropi Zangi app aur QR code ke zariye planning kar rahe the.
🛡️ Actor ki security ko lekar police poori tarah alert par hai.

Is badi khabar par aapki kya rai hai? Apne dosto ke sath share karein aur unhe update karein.
